worldcombat.skill.aerialace.summary: Skim to a flank, then turn into a short reverse cut. Only the returning edge deals damage. Foes can leave its path and walls shorten the maneuver; the user stays near the flank instead of returning to the start.
The reverse cut deals about %1$s Flying contact damage, once per enemy. The ingress deals no damage. Only bodies actually crossed by the return blade are hit; Defence, type match-ups and criticals settle on contact.

The ingress and return share %1$s blocks of travel at %2$s blocks/tick, with a %3$s-block blade spread. Selection fixes the initial flank route; the cut does not chase a departing target. Walls limit the return to reachable space.
worldcombat.skill.aerialace.timing: Range %1$s blocks, windup %2$s s, recover %3$s s, costs %4$s PP, cooldown %5$s s.
worldcombat.skill.aerialace.growth.0: At level %1$s: cut power %2$s and %3$s cuts.
worldcombat.skill.aerialace.growth.1: At level %1$s: cut power %2$s and reach %3$s blocks.
worldcombat.skill.aerialace.use.1: Move out of a frontal approach
worldcombat.skill.aerialace.use.2: Strike across the short returning edge
worldcombat.skill.aerialace.preference.s: On: a broader, lighter edge, slightly shorter travel, and longer windup and cooldown. Off: a narrower, heavier reverse cut.
worldcombat.skill.aerialace.preference.a: Beyond this distance the user closes in instead of dashing. Larger values let it cut in from further.
Prefer a reachable flank when the foe is approaching the user.
On: the user may leave its post to dash at a target; off: it only strikes from where it stands.
